c.tagline: Sun-drenched Algarve gateway of a walled old town and the Ria Formosa lagoon.

taxi.fareNote: Metered fares with surcharges at night, on weekends and from the airport, plus a small luggage fee; short trips have a minimum charge.

emergency.note: 112 is the EU-wide emergency number reaching police, fire and ambulance, with English-speaking operators.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: The walled medieval old town entered through the Arco da Vila, a cluster of cobbled lanes around the cathedral, bishop's palace and bone chapel; Faro's most atmospheric, sightseeing-rich quarter.

The lively pedestrian downtown between the marina and the Manuel Bivar garden, packed with shops, cafes, restaurants and nightlife along Rua de Santo António; the convenient central base for most visitors.
The city's long Atlantic sand beach on the Ancão peninsula at the edge of the Ria Formosa, a strip of beach bars and seafood restaurants; relaxed and summery but a short drive or bus from town.
A quiet residential parish just west of the centre near the airport and university, with local eateries and easy airport access; practical and calm rather than touristy.
A modern residential district on the eastern edge of the city with its own small train halt and everyday amenities; an affordable, local-feeling place to stay near the centre.

water.note: Tap water is safe, though some prefer bottled for taste.

transit.hours: City buses run roughly 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM with reduced weekend service; trains run through the day into the evening.
transit.note: Faro has no metro or tram. Próximo and ViaFaro city buses serve the town, airport and beach, while Comboios de Portugal (CP) trains link Faro along the Algarve line and north to Lisbon and Porto.
transit.pay: Bus fares are paid in cash to the driver or with a rechargeable card; train tickets are bought at station machines, the ticket office or the CP app.

ferry: Ria Formosa ferries to Ilha Deserta, Farol & Culatra (Portas do Mar)
train: Faro railway station (CP — Alfa Pendular, Intercidades, Regional)

transit.m: Próximo bus line 14 or 16 to the bus terminal/centre, ~20 min
Taxi to the city centre, ~10-15 min

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up or leaving ~5-10% for good service in restaurants is appreciated.
